Domain focus: Portfolio-wide analytics supporting all domain product owners. Job Purpose: Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics for Cyber Architecture and Solutions. You turn portfolio, vendor and delivery data into the evidence prioritisation and investment decisions are made from, and you are the analytical backbone of the function. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. What makes this role different. A genuinely analytical role, not a reporting role, and the distinction matters. Producing the pack is the easy part; the value is spotting the trend nobody asked about and bringing it to leadership unprompted. You do not need to have built security controls, but you do need to read a MITRE ATT&CK coverage map and judge for yourself whether two tools genuinely overlap or only appear to in the licence schedule. Your numbers will be used in investment decisions and challenged by people who do not want the answer, so they have to reconcile and you have to defend them. Key responsibilities: This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: Own portfolio intelligence across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions product and project estate. Build and maintain the investment analytics that prioritisation decisions are made from. Produce portfolio reporting the leadership team steers by, and make the numbers defensible under challenge. Analyse vendor spend, performance and value across the managed service, including the OTO transition. Model investment scenarios and quantify trade-offs between competing priorities. Track benefit realisation against the cases that funded the work, including where benefits did not materialise. Own the data and definitions behind the reporting so figures reconcile across every forum. Identify trends and outliers and bring them to leadership attention unprompted. Build the costed option set for the annual plan, sequencing investment and decommission against the renewal calendar so consolidation savings are realised in the year they are claimed. Set the analytical standard for the function — data lineage, definition control and reproducibility — so any figure in a leadership pack can be traced to source and re-derived by someone else. Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
